# Foxquart

> Foxquart is a product engineering studio. It builds the operational software a
> business runs on — ERP, CRM, inventory, warehouse, clinic, school and POS
> systems — plus AI workflow automation, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines and
> mobile field applications. Engagements are custom builds, not templates or
> licensed products.

## What Foxquart is

Foxquart is a software engineering studio, not a web design agency and not a SaaS
vendor. It is hired when a business has outgrown spreadsheets and off-the-shelf
tools, and needs a system modelled on its actual process. Every engagement ships
custom-built software that the client owns outright: full source code,
repositories and infrastructure are transferred on handover.

## Who it is for

Operations-heavy businesses with a manual bottleneck that costs measurable hours.
Foxquart publishes work across ten industries: manufacturing, retail, restaurants,
healthcare, construction, logistics, education, finance, hospitality and real
estate. Typical triggers are re-keying data between disconnected tools, month-end
close done by hand, field teams reporting on paper or WhatsApp, and packaged
software that only fits part of the process.

## Services

Six engineering practices. Most engagements combine two or three.

- [AI Workflow Automation](https://www.foxquart.com/services/ai-automation): Replace repetitive human steps with reliable, auditable automation. Teams re-key data between tools, chase approvals over email, and lose leads because nobody responded within the hour.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.foxquart.com/services/custom-software-development): Operational systems built around how your business actually runs. Off-the-shelf software forces your process into someone else's template, and the gaps get filled with spreadsheets.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps](https://www.foxquart.com/services/cloud-devops): Infrastructure that scales quietly and recovers automatically. Deploys are manual and risky, downtime is discovered by customers, and nobody is certain the backups restore.
- [Data Intelligence & Scraping](https://www.foxquart.com/services/data-intelligence): Turn public and internal data into a live decision feed. Pricing, competitor and market data is collected by hand, weeks late, and it never reaches the people deciding.
- [Enterprise Websites & Landing Pages](https://www.foxquart.com/services/enterprise-websites): Fast, indexable, conversion-engineered web presence. Marketing sites load slowly, rank poorly and force a developer ticket for every content change.
- [Mobile & Field Applications](https://www.foxquart.com/services/mobile-applications): Apps for the people doing the work, not just the office. Field teams report on paper or WhatsApp, so the office finds out what happened a day late.

### Service capabilities

**AI Workflow Automation** (https://www.foxquart.com/services/ai-automation)
- n8n workflow engineering
- Lead qualification & routing
- Invoice and document automation
- Email and WhatsApp automation
- Multi-step approval systems
- AI agents & knowledge assistants
Stack: n8n, OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Postgres, Redis.

**Custom Software Development** (https://www.foxquart.com/services/custom-software-development)
- ERP & CRM platforms
- Inventory and warehouse systems
- POS and restaurant operations
- Hospital, school and clinic systems
- Construction & manufacturing platforms
- Internal tools and admin dashboards
Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Docker.

**Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps** (https://www.foxquart.com/services/cloud-devops)
- Docker & Kubernetes deployment
- CI/CD pipelines
- Load balancing & autoscaling
- Monitoring and alerting
- Backups & disaster recovery
- Managed hosting with 24/7 cover
Stack: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Cloudflare.

**Data Intelligence & Scraping** (https://www.foxquart.com/services/data-intelligence)
- Web scraping at scale
- Browser automation
- Competitor & price monitoring
- Scheduled extraction pipelines
- Custom data APIs
- BI and analytics dashboards
Stack: Playwright, Puppeteer, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Metabase.

**Enterprise Websites & Landing Pages** (https://www.foxquart.com/services/enterprise-websites)
- Enterprise and marketing sites
- High-converting landing pages
- Technical SEO & structured data
- Headless CMS integration
- Core Web Vitals optimisation
- Analytics and experimentation
Stack: React, Next.js, TanStack, Tailwind, Cloudflare, Headless CMS.

**Mobile & Field Applications** (https://www.foxquart.com/services/mobile-applications)
- Field service applications
- Delivery & logistics apps
- Inventory scanning apps
- Internal business tools
- Offline-first sync
- Push notification workflows
Stack: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Supabase, Node.js.

## Solutions

17 solution pages, each covering one problem in detail: the failure modes, the
system Foxquart builds, and what changes afterwards. Each maps to a parent service.

- [Inventory Management Software Development](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/inventory-management-software): Custom inventory management software with real-time stock, multi-location transfers, barcode scanning and reorder automation. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [ERP Development Services](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/erp-development): Modular ERP development covering finance, inventory, procurement, production and reporting, modelled on your real process. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [Custom CRM Development](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/crm-development): Custom CRM development with pipeline automation, AI lead scoring, quoting and revenue reporting. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [n8n Automation Services](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/n8n-automation-services): Production-grade n8n automation: self-hosted workflows, error handling, monitoring and AI-powered decision steps. Parent service: AI Workflow Automation.
- [AI Automation Services For Business](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/ai-automation-services): AI agents, document processing, OCR and knowledge assistants integrated into your existing business systems. Parent service: AI Workflow Automation.
- [Business Process Automation](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/business-process-automation): Process mapping, automation engineering and change rollout that removes repetitive work across departments. Parent service: AI Workflow Automation.
- [Managed Cloud Hosting](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/cloud-hosting): Managed cloud hosting with monitoring, backups, scaling and 24/7 incident response on AWS, Azure and GCP. Parent service: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps.
- [Managed DevOps Services](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/managed-devops): CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and observability delivered as a managed service. Parent service: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps.
- [Web Scraping & Data Extraction Services](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/web-scraping): Large-scale web scraping, browser automation and scheduled data extraction delivered as clean APIs and dashboards. Parent service: Data Intelligence & Scraping.
- [Landing Page Development](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/landing-page-development): High-performance landing page development with conversion copy, analytics and sub-second load times. Parent service: Enterprise Websites & Landing Pages.
- [Restaurant POS & Management Software](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/restaurant-software): Restaurant POS, kitchen display, recipe costing and multi-branch reporting built for hospitality operations. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [Warehouse Management Software](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/warehouse-software): WMS development with bin-level tracking, guided picking, dispatch planning and courier integrations. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [Manufacturing ERP Development](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/manufacturing-erp): Manufacturing ERP covering BOM, production planning, machine downtime, quality control and costing. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [Healthcare & Hospital Software](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/healthcare-software): Hospital and clinic systems: patient records, appointments, pharmacy, billing and compliance-ready audit trails. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [School ERP Development](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/school-erp): School management system with admissions, attendance, timetables, fees, exams and parent communication. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [Custom Software Development Company](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/custom-software-development-services): Custom software development covering discovery, architecture, delivery and long-term maintenance. Parent service: Custom Software Development.
- [API Development Services](https://www.foxquart.com/solutions/api-development): REST, GraphQL and event-driven API development with versioning, documentation and rate limiting. Parent service: Data Intelligence & Scraping.

## Industries served

- **Manufacturing** — Problem: Production plans on paper, downtime invisible until month-end. Foxquart builds: Shop-floor ERP with work orders, downtime capture and batch costing.
- **Retail** — Problem: Stock accuracy drifts across branches and channels. Foxquart builds: Unified inventory, POS and replenishment automation.
- **Restaurants** — Problem: Food cost unknown until it has already been lost. Foxquart builds: POS, kitchen display and recipe-level consumption tracking.
- **Healthcare** — Problem: Patient data fragmented across paper and legacy systems. Foxquart builds: Unified records, scheduling, pharmacy and audit trails.
- **Construction** — Problem: Site progress and material usage reported days late. Foxquart builds: Project ERP with mobile site reporting and procurement control.
- **Logistics** — Problem: Dispatch planning by phone call and whiteboard. Foxquart builds: Route planning, driver app and live delivery tracking.
- **Education** — Problem: Fees, attendance and results managed in parallel spreadsheets. Foxquart builds: School ERP with parent portal and payment automation.
- **Finance** — Problem: Manual reconciliation and compliance reporting. Foxquart builds: Automated reconciliation, document AI and audit-ready logging.
- **Hospitality** — Problem: Bookings, housekeeping and billing in separate tools. Foxquart builds: Property operations platform with channel integrations.
- **Real Estate** — Problem: Leads lost between portals, agents and follow-up. Foxquart builds: CRM with lead scoring, WhatsApp automation and pipeline reporting.

## How engagements work

- Discovery is fixed price and happens before any delivery commitment.
- Delivery runs in two-week increments of working software, either fixed-scope per
  phase or as a dedicated team retainer.
- The client receives full IP: source code, repositories, infrastructure and
  documentation are transferred on handover.
- Foxquart takes over existing codebases, starting with an architecture and risk
  audit before adding features.
- Existing tools are automated around rather than replaced, unless a tool is the
  bottleneck.
- Ongoing support and improvement agreements are available after launch.
